author_observations.result: Cursor invisible at fullscreen MainMenu using a disposable copy of run_dev.bat configuration.
Cursor remained invisible after vid_cursor None was reassigned at ten seconds; fullscreen stayed enabled.
Author reported cursor still invisible after scheduled false/true fullscreen requests; clicking removes the keyboard Sun selector.
Author reported manual Alt+Enter twice did not restore the cursor.
Author reports standard Windows arrow also invisible in fullscreen Vulkan.
Invalid warm-start attempt: -window alone did not override fullscreen=true; no windowed claim.
Author corrected the initial answer: cursor visible in windowed Vulkan, invisible after entering fullscreen.
Author confirms Caelum cursor visible in fullscreen OpenGL.
Native exclusive-fullscreen Vulkan preference: initially invisible; author later reports Alt+Tab makes cursor appear. This is focus recovery, not startup success.
Author confirms cursor visible from fullscreen Vulkan startup with vid_vsync=true, before Alt+Tab or mode changes.
Author confirms cursor visible from a second fullscreen Vulkan startup, before Alt+Tab or mode changes; clicks work in MainMenu, Options and Create Character.
Author confirms mouse camera input, cursor hidden during play, visible in menus and hidden again after closing the menu.
Author approved keeping Vulkan with VSync enabled and requested commit, push, issue closure and PR merge.

limits: Fullscreen Computer Use captures show other desktop windows instead of reliable game frames. Physical-display conclusions use explicit author observations.
CVar request logging does not prove a display transition was presented while the process was unfocused.

acceptance.scope: Two fullscreen Vulkan startups; MainMenu/Options/creator clicks; menu/gameplay capture transitions on the author machine.
